definition.contact: link net force magnitude > 1 N; foot order FL,FR,RL,RR
definition.event: live adjacent sample contact transition; no cross-reset transitions
definition.phase: first FR+RL pair touchdown within consecutive FL+RR pair touchdown cycle; circular mean degrees; undefined if no cycles
definition.foot_release: sum(abs(actual yaw rate) * any foot off) / sum(abs(actual yaw rate)); forward case uses abs(actual vx) instead; not causal slip evidence
